fix.shows: From its RTI applications and its reporting on the Commission's software, the Collective finds that the SIR gave officers no way to record anyone as a foreigner. The Commission passed its questions on cases referred under the Citizenship Act to Bihar alone. The Bihar replies it reproduces answer No to whether any list was referred and give the constituency's names left off by reason, with no category for people who are not citizens. It sets this beside the Home Minister's statement that the Leader of the Opposition was protecting infiltrators.

fix.shows: Reads the Form 10 registers published with West Bengal's final roll for 284 of the 294 constituencies and finds 5,23,998 names deleted on Form 7s that give the Electoral Registration Officer as the objector and leave the reason blank. It quotes the Chief Electoral Officer's statement of 6 March 2026 that the state's Form 7 figure included forms the Commission's software generated when an officer did not approve an elector at a hearing, and puts those at 5,38,320 of the state's 5.46 lakh Form 7 deletions. It breaks the deletions down by district and by the party that won each seat, and sets them against the 2026 margins.

'shows' rewritten from the print text: the body names a Hyderabad resident who listed 17 family members and 13 neighbours, and a 76-year-old rickshaw driver; both are private persons and are not named. fix.shows: Reports from Hyderabad, where the revision was in its last phase, on residents of a Muslim neighbourhood whose names were left off the draft roll, one of whom said 17 members of his family and 13 neighbours were left off, his family as permanently shifted. It sets out critics' view that the revision wrongly took eligible voters off the rolls, many of them Muslim, and may have helped the Prime Minister's party, and notes that protesters have produced no evidence that it changed any result. It quotes a former election commissioner calling the exercise aggressive, ambitious and abrupt, and the Commission's reply that its decisions follow standard administrative practice and that it has directed officials to restore eligible voters left off in error. The 130 million in its headline are names left off the drafts.
